comments.author: Shirin
comments.body:
This figurehead is an adventrurers figurehead the seaweed removal skill is something that you cannot just buy an item for an cure which makes this cool so you can save a skill slot for something else rather than have eradication skill

The Crisis prevntion is rather high so very low chance of disasters which is good for no krakens, fire, sirens etc..

The rather good cannon evade is good for evading cannon hits from pirates so you can flee from them and not get one shotted when you do your port hops or Shipwrecks

This is worth around 7-15mil depending on how high the great success dura is

comments.body: in addition to what I said this recipe is good for when you do dungeons that have pearls in it you can make a bunch of these figureheads and sell for an added bonus to your profit! also it can be made for only 5 pearls you cant beat that with a stick.
